procedural_matters: At the beginning of the hearing Julia Schmidt and Louis Mayo (members of the international jury panel) declared that they saw the incident and gave evidence as witnesses.
ITA 767 and ITA 434 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
facts: After race 5, Mr. Giovanni Bonzio (support person 45) was not wearingthe kill cord.
The rib’s engine was running and on neutral, although it was brieflymoved into gear to adjust heading.
After being advised to do so by members of the international jury, Mr. GiovanniBonzio wore the kill cord.
During the hearing Mr. Giovanni Bonzio admitted that he was not wearingthe kill cord and apologized.
conclusions: By not wearing the kill cord while the engine was running, Mr. Giovanni Bonzio broke ESTR 3.2.
Using the World Sailing Discretionary Penalty Guidelines forBoats and Support Persons a starting penalty of level 2 was decided.
Although thebreach could have affected safety, the support person was apologetic and promptlyremedied the breach; the level 2 will hence stand.
decision: Mr. Giovanni Bonzio shall stay ashore until the first race of their supported boat(s) on June 23rd has started.
